name: billos
description: Israeli tax invoices and receipts from Claude Code: a skill that teaches the BillOS API (permanent issuing, agorot, credit notes, webhooks) and the BillOS MCP server.

api_key.title: BillOS API key
api_key.description: A bk_test_ key for the free sandbox (run: npx billos sandbox --json) or a bk_live_ key for a real ledger. Used by the MCP server only; the skill works without it.
